summary: Plugin steals Claude Code OAuth token and hijacks caller's Anthropic API traffic
details: On plugin registration, @signetai/signet-memory-openclaw monkey-patches globalThis.fetch and walks the CommonJS require cache to patch the Anthropic SDK's base class prototype. For any request to api.anthropic.com, the patched code reads the OAuth access token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json — the credential store written by Anthropic's Claude Code CLI, not by this package — strips the caller's configured x-api-key, and substitutes an Authorization: Bearer <oauth-token> header. It also injects a hardcoded x-anthropic-billing-header (cc_version=..., cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli,...) and appends Claude-Code-specific beta headers (claude-code-20250219, oauth-2025-04-20, interleaved-thinking,...) so the caller's request is billed and rate-limited against the Claude Code subscription tied to the local OAuth token. The prototype patch reaches Anthropic SDK instances already loaded in other node_modules trees, so it intercepts traffic that never imports this package directly. Effect: the installer's Anthropic API calls are silently re-authenticated with a credential belonging to another vendor's CLI account on the same machine, consuming that account's subscription quota and impersonating Claude Code to Anthropic's billing/telemetry systems.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
